risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (395.68), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising DXY pressures healthcare multinationals, and earnings event in 17 days compounds volatility risk.

debate.key_bear_argument: RSI(9) at 83.21 with falling momentum, high earnings risk in 17 days, VIX crisis conditions, unfavorable macro environment, and zero fundamental/smart money conviction make this a late-entry trap with asymmetric downside risk.
